name: Arrow Minerals Limited
summary: Arrow Minerals Limited engages in the mineral exploration in Western Australia. The company primarily explores for gold, lithium, nickel, and copper deposits. It owns 100% interests in the Strickland Gold project covering an area of 1,150 square kilometers exploration licenses located in the Eastern Goldfields; the Malinda Lithium project comprising an area of approximately 600 square kilometers of exploration licences in the Gascoyne Region of Western Australia; and 10% interests in the Plumridge Nickel project covering an area of approximately 1,880 square kilometers located in Fraser Range province. It also holds interests in the Divole East project covering an area of 194 square kilometers located in the Boromo-Poura Shear Zone; the Boulsa project that consists of 684 square kilometers located in Markoye Fault corridor; and the Hounde South/Nako projects located in Burkino Faso. The company was formerly known as Segue Resources Limited and changed its name to Arrow Minerals Limited in December 2017. Arrow Minerals Limited was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Claremont, Australia.
